pages.text: Warrior woman of Themiscyra (40 health, damage 8, armour 10), in the camps and the city. She fights monsters, and if you hurt her she answers together with her sisters.
Courtship: give flowers, gold, weapons, trophies or food, once every 20 seconds. Right-click with an empty hand: she says what she likes best, and that gift counts double.
At affection 100, give her a wedding ring (a diamond over three gold ingots). Your wife follows you and fights at your side. Shift + right-click: follow, stay or wander nearby.
Give your wife a cake and a daughter is born, once a day. In 20 minutes she grows into an amazon loyal to your family. Hitting an amazon costs a lot of affection.

Above all, amazons love the necklace of Harmonia: give it and she falls in love at once (affection 100). It cannot be crafted; it lies in the treasuries of temples, the labyrinth and the monsters' lairs.
Amazons keep to their camp. If they have wandered off, blow the horn of Themiscyra (a goat horn, gold and leather): everyone around goes back home.

Cannot wait for your daughter to grow up? Throw a splash potion of growth at her (a glass bottle, bone meal, a golden carrot and gunpowder): she is grown at once. The potion grows up any other young creature too.
The family whistle (gold, an iron nugget and an ender pearl): right-click and all your wives and daughters come to you at once, even from another world.
